title: Google Technical Writing defines audience-aware and verifiable technical communication
locator: Technical Writing One: Audience; Short Sentences; Lists and Tables
paraphrase: Google's technical-writing guidance requires writers to identify audience needs, use precise and concise sentences, organize ordered steps as numbered lists, and structure technical information so readers can perform intended tasks.
scope: Practice evidence for Volume 01 instruction clarity, problem communication, reviewable design notes, and delivery documentation; it does not define programming-language semantics.
